bio: Atelier Sanssouci – the name alone sounds stylish, and this wonderful 18C estate certainly lives up to it! Not only is the exterior with its magnificent garden a veritable feast for the eyes, but the interior is also a sight to behold. The large dining room done out in an elegant Mediterranean style boasts remarkable chandeliers and a high ceiling. And the sophisticated cuisine is on a par with this romantic setting. First-rate ingredients are used to create a successful blend of classic and modern dishes. Choose five to 10 courses to make up your meal, or just specify the number of courses and let the kitchen surprise you. The food is accompanied by a harmonious selection of wines, and the service is attentive and professional. Tasteful guestrooms for overnight stays....
